description: Source code for a Kivy application showcasing various UI features and layouts, including screen management, dynamic widget addition, and source code viewing.

classes.name: ShowcaseScreen
classes.description: A custom Screen class with a BooleanProperty for fullscreen and an overridden add_widget method.

classes.name: ShowcaseApp
classes.description: Main application class managing screens, source code display, and dynamic layout demonstrations.

methods.name: add_widget
methods.description: Adds a widget to the 'content' id if present, otherwise calls superclass method.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Initializes the app, sets title, schedules clock updates, loads screens, and starts with the first screen.

methods.name: on_pause
methods.description: Handles app pause event, returns True.

methods.name: on_resume
methods.description: Handles app resume event, currently does nothing.

methods.name: on_current_title
methods.description: Updates the spinner text when current title changes.

methods.name: go_previous_screen
methods.description: Navigates to the previous screen in the list.

methods.name: go_next_screen
methods.description: Navigates to the next screen in the list.

methods.name: go_screen
methods.description: Loads and switches to a specific screen by index.

methods.name: go_hierarchy_previous
methods.description: Navigates back in the hierarchy stack.

methods.name: load_screen
methods.description: Loads a screen from file if not already loaded.

methods.name: read_sourcecode
methods.description: Reads the source code of the current screen file.

methods.name: toggle_source_code
methods.description: Toggles the display of source code with animation.

methods.name: update_sourcecode
methods.description: Updates the source code display area with current file content.

methods.name: showcase_floatlayout
methods.description: Demonstrates dynamic addition of buttons in a FloatLayout.

methods.name: showcase_boxlayout
methods.description: Demonstrates dynamic addition of buttons in a BoxLayout with orientation toggle.

methods.name: showcase_gridlayout
methods.description: Demonstrates dynamic addition of buttons in a GridLayout with row/column adjustments.

methods.name: showcase_stacklayout
methods.description: Demonstrates dynamic addition of buttons in a StackLayout with orientation cycling.

methods.name: showcase_anchorlayout
methods.description: Demonstrates changing anchor points in an AnchorLayout.

methods.name: _update_clock
methods.description: Updates the internal clock property with current time.
